title: Determination of a metric and a unitary connection from one boundary patch
main_claim: For compact M of dimension n≥3 with boundary and a nonempty open patch Γ⊂∂M, the Dirichlet energy form on C_c^∞(Γ;C^2) of the connection Laplacian d_A^*d_A determines the pair (g,A), with A a u(2) connection on the trivial C^2 bundle. It does so up to a diffeomorphism Φ and a gauge U:M→U(2), with Φ|_Γ=Id and U|_Γ=I.

issues.location: Sections 3-5 (product continuation and angular coercivity), together with the scalar companion
issues.description: Not a located error, only a caution. Applied with A=0 and through the scalar companion, the result settles the smooth anisotropic Calderón problem in n≥3, a well-known open problem. All the analytic weight sits on the a priori angular coercivity estimate (Prop. ang:scalar-coercivity and ang:system-coercivity), which gives an L^2 bound on the transfer density that is uniform as the spheres shrink. I re-derived the raising estimate and the norm-comparison identity. I only spot-checked the (3,1) order/weight count and the claim that no third base derivative survives; I did not fully re-derive them.
issues.evidence: I checked these and found them consistent. (1) Raising estimate: the |D^+v|^2 coefficient is (2+2/d)[d−k−ϑ(n−1)+ϑζ(k+n−1)] with d−k=(n−2)/2>0, and the Hessian term carries positive coefficients (d−1+ϑ) and (1−ϑ)k. (2) The ‖(2T+U)φ‖²−‖(2T^♭+U^†)φ‖² expansion produces exactly the stated error operator E. (3) D_i^+ r^{-1}A_j^* = r^{-1}A_j^* D_i^+ via [B,A^*]=A^*. (4) ‖φ‖_{L²H¹} ≤ β_0^{-1}N absorbs the bounded Ψ^1 system terms.

coverage: Read all seven sections in full. Re-derived the following. Boundary jets: det C=(det k)^{m−1}, and the trace-free argument needs m≥2. Cap minimizer competitor. Point-distribution order argument for surjectivity and the 2-jet space. Section 3: the convex-separation split into rank-one tests (covariance argument), the tube-test identity ω·(U1−U2)=b·U2, and the quadratic |b|^2 lower bound near b=0. Section 4: the moving-sphere test, where the |b|^2 terms cancel to O(|b|^3) and positivity comes from −r²Hess f* ≥ cr²β; error ratios 1/β, rβ², ε, ε²/β; profile lemma. Section 5: the P-equation derivation, the P0=2T+U+J decomposition and its bounds, the raising estimate algebra, the norm-comparison/error identity, P0·1 bounded, and system-coercivity absorption. Section 6: the Taylor transfer and the D−M bound, interpolation exponents (ηd*=1/2, η(m−10)≥3/2, η>1/p*), and the comparison identity checked term by term with the ordering of the matrix drifts. Also: Π/q projections killing the hI and d^iI derivative terms, the scalar direction d^l from the exact trace coordinates, CK finite type ((n−2)Hess σ=−δΔσ ⇒ (2n−2)Δσ=0), Gronwall on the vertical segment, and the continuity argument (I is an interval; closed, open, and the improvement step). Section 7: conformal removal (C2=C1−dφI, Δ e^φ=0), unitarity of J via parallel transport, boundary completion, and Φ|_Γ=Id. Not fully re-derived: the (3,1) count and the third-base-derivative cancellation in scalar coercivity, and the trace-operator symbol expansion (Lemma ang:trace).
sibling_notes: The board already had two no_gap_found passes on this same paper (rank 198). This third independent pass agrees.
